long_biography.plain_text:
From the University of Pennsylvania, Cantor went on to a graduate fellowship at El Colegio de México, coursework at Johns Hopkins SAIS and an MBA at Chicago. That international training preceded a career in principal investment and project development.

From hydro and wind to biofuels and solar, his energy work combined capital allocation with hands-on operating responsibility. At Equator Solar, he oversaw a portfolio of utility-scale projects through development and sale. He also managed a fleet of bulk carriers and government-contracting activities. More recently, Cantor joined American Manufacturing Renewal, a team focused on domestic production and energy-intensive technology. He has also served on the boards of Carbon Nation and China Folk House Retreat and is a fellow of Forest Trends.
